job.purpose: q-tile spec r5 leaf 1: ot_qwen_tile_rpair = one ROM bank row (2 ot_rom_4096x266_m8 + its MPR request registers, capture/expansion rungs, select, group+relay registers; ~4.5k flops), hardened once and used x5 in the tile; the leaf owns the ROM clock (removes the flat 48k-sink root's W-channel ROM clock buffers behind DRT-0255). Pure re-hierarchy of g_rom_pipe (RPH=1 exact against the tile reference); outline 311.04 x 129.6 (3 x 43.2 child lattice: the 20 um macro-to-edge rule needs >= 103 um; ROM pitch 95.04 is not on the lattice).

benches.name: rpair_rom_pipe_exact
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && python3 tools/rtl_qwen_me_partition_gate_w12.py --ref-file tools/qwen_blocks/ot_hdc_matvec_0e8df511.sv --jobs 8 --param GT=16 --param W=4 --param SMIN=3 --param SMAX=4 --param TCUT=3 --param BD=2 --param NWS=1 --param ORD=1 --param TWS=2 --param MEM_EXTRA=1 --param ACC_LAT=7 --param TREE_LAT=7 --param MUL_LAT=8 --param FAST_ISSUE=1 --param KV_PREP=4 --param ROM_PIPE=1 --param LRST=3 --param ARPB=1 --param MPR=1 --param HIER=2 --param ROM_CAP2=1 --param ROM_CAPX=2 --param ANR=1 --param ROM_ARELAY=2 --param HIER_HARD=1 --param TOREG=1 --param TIDR=1 --param LRR=1 --param RPH=1 --param SEED=1 --workdir {RUN}/bench/rpair_rom_pipe_exact --result {RUN}/bench/rpair_rom_pipe_exact.json; python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('{RUN}/bench/rpair_rom_pipe_exact.json'));print(('PASS' if d['status']=='pass' else 'FAIL')+' rom_pipe '+d['verdict']+' | neg '+d['negative_control']);sys.exit(0 if d['status']=='pass' else 1)"
